summary: Iteration 31 testing: Bug C ✅ FIXED, Feature D backend ✅ FIXED, Feature D admin frontend ✅ FIXED, Bug B avatar PDF ✅ FIXED, Bug A ❌ BROKEN — BriefBody throws 'ReferenceError: Empty is not defined' when admin opens the floating Personnel Brief in Reports tab. The new BriefBody component references <Empty /> 8 times (lines 702, 712, 718, 727, 735, 745, 753, 759, 790 of /app/frontend/src/pages/Reports.jsx) but never imports or defines an Empty component. Backend: 14/14 new pytest cases pass, combined regression 99/99 passes (~36s). Frontend: home page founder CDN images all load (8/8 customer-assets.emergentagent.com images OK, 0 rewritten by mediaUrl), Admin → Pages tab renders ProfileLayoutAdmin with 6 section rows + 'Custom profile fields' card + 'Add field (0/12)' + 'Save layout', Personnel Brief tab modal opens but the body crashes with the missing-Empty ReferenceError so brief-body / brief-section-* testids never mount.

ui_bugs.issue: Uncaught ReferenceError: 'Empty is not defined' when the floating Personnel Brief renders. The component is referenced 8x as <Empty /> at lines 702, 712, 718, 727, 735, 745, 753, 759 (empty-state fallback for degrees/languages/dues/donations/hoursCY/awards/eventRows/assignments) AND at line 790 (visible.length===0 case), but `Empty` is never imported or defined anywhere in Reports.jsx. As a result, opening the admin floating Personnel Brief shows the CRA error overlay; brief-body and brief-section-1..brief-section-10 never mount. Bug A is NOT actually resolved.

Reproduction: 1) login admin@clubhaven.app, 2) /admin → click data-testid='admin-tab-reports' → click data-testid='reports-tab-brief', 3) pick any member in data-testid='brief-member-select', 4) click data-testid='brief-generate-btn'. The modal opens but the body fails to mount; the dev overlay shows 'Empty is not defined at BriefBody'. Mitigation (one-line fix): add `const Empty = () => —;` (or any small placeholder component) near the top of BriefBody / above the file's BriefBody declaration. After that single change, the 10 brief-section-N testids will mount and the iter31 Bug A acceptance criteria will be met.
